➕ కొత్త ఐటమ్

👤 Lab account

🏥 ల్యాబ్ వివరాలు (బిల్ / రిపోర్ట్ PDF పై)

Patients scan the QR to pay the exact amount. It shows on the bill screen when the payment mode is UPI, and on bills that still have a balance (PDF and WhatsApp).

📄 రిపోర్ట్ ఫార్మాట్

పై / కింద ఖాళీ ప్రీ-ప్రింటెడ్ పేపర్‌కి మాత్రమే.
Profiles (CBC, LFT, KFT, Lipid, Thyroid, Urine …) each get their own page. Single tests (FBS, Creatinine, Blood Group, Widal …) are printed together in one table after the profiles.
ఖాళీగా ఉంటే: QR స్కాన్ చేస్తే ఈ యాప్ లింక్‌లోనే రిపోర్ట్ తెరుచుకుంటుంది (యాప్ వెబ్‌సైట్ లింక్‌లో ఉన్నప్పుడు). మీ వెబ్‌సైట్‌లో PDF లు పెడితే ఆ ఫోల్డర్ లింక్ ఇవ్వండి.

🧾 బిల్ నంబర్ & టెస్ట్ రేట్లు

👁️ టెస్ట్ పారామీటర్లు హైడ్ / రీస్టోర్

మీ ల్యాబ్‌లో చేయని పారామీటర్లను (ఉదా: PDW, MPV) హైడ్ చేయండి — టెస్ట్ ఎంపికలో కనిపించవు. ఎప్పుడైనా ఒక్క క్లిక్‌తో రీస్టోర్ చేయవచ్చు. పాత రిపోర్టులు మారవు.

🎨 Appearance & Stock

A4 reports and bills always print on white paper, whatever theme is selected.

🔊 Payment sound (soundbox)

When a payment is saved (bill, due collection, outsource), the phone plays a ding-dong and says the amount, e.g. “250 rupees received”. It does not see money arriving in your bank — check your UPI app for that.

☁️ Google Drive vault

Report PDFs (outside-lab originals and your own) are copied to a private folder LabFlow_Cloud_Vault_<LabID> in your Google Drive, then removed from this phone. Search a patient and tap 👁 / ⬇ / 📲 to bring any report back in seconds.
Runs by itself while the app is open. When Google sign-in needs renewing, a Google window may open for a second on your next tap.
🏢 Lab profiles (multi-lab)
Every bill, report and patient carries a lab_id. Create more labs to keep their records separate under one login; tap a lab to switch. Each lab has its own branding, rates, stock, reference labs, sample-ID series and bill-number prefix (e.g. BL-000001, SL-000001). Tap ⇄ to make a lab a 📦 support / collection lab. The 🚚 Outsource Hub can show one lab or all labs together (central log).
🔐 Security — master PIN
Locks the app screen on this device (also after 2 minutes in the background). It is an access barrier, not encryption.

🛠 App owner tools

Only for the person who sets up and gives this app to labs. Labs never need this section.
☁️ Google Drive
Do this once before giving the app to labs: Google Cloud Console → enable “Google Drive API” → OAuth consent screen → Credentials → OAuth client ID (Web application) → add your https site (Netlify / Vercel) under Authorized JavaScript origins. Paste the ID here or into GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID in the file. The app only uses the “drive.file” permission, so it can see only the files it creates.
🔥 Firebase (mobile OTP) — app owner only
Placeholder for future cloud hosting. Leave empty to stay 100% offline. Paste your Firebase web-app config (Project settings → Your apps). Phone OTP needs the app to be hosted on an https domain that is listed under Firebase Auth → Authorized domains (e.g. Netlify / Vercel).
Data path: tenants/<your uid>/labs/<lab_id>/records. Newer record (by update time) wins on download.
